description: Controls specific attack behavior for Ocelots.

cooldown_time.description: Time (in seconds) between attacks. Value must be > 0.

max_distance.description: Max distance from the target, this entity will use this attack behavior. Value must be > 0.

max_sneak_range.description: Max distance from the target, this entity starts sneaking. Value must be > 0.

max_sprint_range.description: Max distance from the target, this entity starts sprinting (sprinting takes priority over sneaking). Value must be > 0.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

reach_multiplier.description: Used with the base size of the entity to determine minimum target-distance before trying to deal attack damage. Value must be > 0.

sneak_speed_multiplier.description: Modifies the attacking entity's movement speed while sneaking. Value must be > 0.

sprint_speed_multiplier.description: Modifies the attacking entity's movement speed while sprinting. Value must be > 0.

walk_speed_multiplier.description: Modifies the attacking entity's movement speed when not sneaking or sprinting, but still within attack range. Value must be > 0.

x_max_rotation.description: Maximum rotation (in degrees), on the X-axis, this entity can rotate while trying to look at the target. Value must be > 0.

y_max_head_rotation.description: Maximum rotation (in degrees), on the Y-axis, this entity's head can rotate while trying to look at the target. Value must be > 0.
